Definition: Elzabad, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elzabad is the name of two Israelites. In 1 Chronicles 12:12, the text says "Elzabad the ninth."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elzabad matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
